purpose: Security and integrity boundaries for Shine applications that store, calculate with or present personal financial data.
requirements: Financial records and derived views are available only inside an authenticated, authorised user or household boundary.
Authentication credentials and session secrets are stored separately from financial records and are never returned in ordinary application responses.
Session cookies are HttpOnly, Secure in production, deliberately SameSite scoped and protected from cross-site state-changing requests.
Login and other credential-bearing request bodies are byte-bounded before parsing, input validated, abuse throttled and use generic authentication failure responses.
Financial imports and backups are size-bounded, schema-validated and fail closed on malformed or unsupported data before changing stored records.
Money amounts, dates, account identities and transaction semantics are validated before persistence or calculation; invalid numeric values do not silently become zero.
Derived balances, forecasts and scenarios distinguish recorded facts from assumptions, estimates and modelled values.
Concurrency-sensitive corrections or restores detect stale state rather than silently overwriting newer financial records.
Exports, logs, telemetry and error messages minimise financial detail and exclude passwords, session credentials and unnecessary private record content.
External provider or bank-derived data preserves source and freshness context; stale or failed retrieval is not represented as current.
AI or assistant features receive only the financial context needed for the task and cannot bypass authentication, ownership or advice-boundary controls.
Irreversible deletion, bulk replacement or authority-changing operations require deterministic validation and an explicit user action appropriate to the product flow.
When authentication, storage integrity or a critical dependency cannot establish a trustworthy result, protected financial operations fail closed.
nonClaims: This policy does not make financial records complete or current.
This policy does not provide financial product advice or determine suitability.
This policy does not guarantee a bank or external provider is correct or available.
This policy does not certify an application merely because it performs financial calculations.
